title: Tracking
description: Cameras and biometric fingerprint devices for attendance
camerasHint: Connect your existing NVR / camera portal by URL
biometricsHint: Fingerprint terminals that send punches to ERP
camerasDesc: Paste your camera system / NVR live URL — open it from ERP
biometricsDesc: Register devices and map badge IDs to employees for attendance
cameraConnectHint: If the company already has cameras/NVR (Hikvision, Dahua, etc.), paste the live view or portal URL here. ERP stores it and opens it — no special SDK required for viewing.
biometricConnectHint: Point the device (or its middleware) to this punch webhook. Set each employee’s Fingerprint/badge ID on their HR profile. Punches create attendance PRESENT/LATE and check-in/out.
biometricPunchBody: JSON body: { deviceKey, eventType: "IN"|"OUT", externalRef: "badgeId", occurredAt?: ISO }. Absence stays manual/HR until end-of-day jobs mark missing punches.
